subject: Secure dev: codeflow justification and secrets ownership (SIG request)
messages:
From: Amanda Reed <amanda.reed@acme-assess.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: pq-auditor@cloudassess.org, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 07 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG evidence request: code review, CI gating, and secrets ownership

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking our SIG questionnaire. We have a follow-up from the assessor team: they need concrete artifacts demonstrating your Secure SDLC controls for the services used by Acme Financial Services. Specifically:

- A short example of a merged PR showing code review comments and approval gate (redact customer data).
- CI/CD pipeline snapshot showing gating (PR checks, failing build behavior).
- Secrets rotation and ownership log for credentials used by the service (who is the secret owner, rotation cadence).
- Change management evidence for a production hotfix (approval stamps, rollback plan).

Can you provide the items or point me to a single bundle? If any items are restricted, indicate what we can provide instead (e.g., high-level screenshots + redacted logs).

We'd like to close this scope by EOD Tuesday (2025-12-09). Please let me know if that's feasible.

—Amanda
Amanda Reed
Senior Assessor, Acme Assess
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Reed <amanda.reed@acme-assess.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 07 Dec 2025 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: code review, CI gating, and secrets ownership

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a consolidated pack. Quick notes up front: we prefer to share redacted artifacts and an index file rather than raw logs for PIIs.

Action plan (high level):
1) Marissa will pull a redacted merged PR and the branch protection snapshot.
2) I will export the CI gating configuration and a policy snapshot from our CI system.
3) Jonas will pull the secret rotation CSV and confirm ownership mapping for the service account keys.
4) I'll consolidate a change-approval audit (production hotfix) with timestamps and reviewer IDs.

Target: bundle uploaded to a secure share by EOD Tue (2025-12-09). If something slips, we will send an interim summary by EOD Mon.

Attachments included in next mail: code_review_sample.md, ci_policy_snapshot.pdf.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Amanda Reed <amanda.reed@acme-assess.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: code review, CI gating, and secrets ownership

Attached: code_review_sample.md (redacted PR), ci_policy_snapshot.pdf (pipeline gating rules). Summary below.

Summary of artifacts provided:
- PR evidence: example PR #4387 (redacted) showing two approvers, one security comment flagged and addressed. We include the merged timestamp and the approval audit trail. The PR demonstrates our mandatory CODEOWNERS review + at least one peer and one security approver.
- Branch protection: master/main requires passing CI checks and 2 approvals; admins cannot bypass without recorded justification.
- CI gating: pipeline stages 'lint -> unit -> integration -> canary-deploy' are enforced. A failing stage blocks merges; artifacts show a failed run and automatic rollback behavior.
- Change management (hotfix): included small change-approval-audit.txt showing ticket number (JIRA-1234), approvers (SRE lead + Product), and rollback window.

Notes on secrets: we do not share raw secrets. Jonas will provide a rotation log that shows hash identifiers, rotation timestamps, and owner mappings (no secret material). Our secret owner model: each service has an on-call owner (engineering manager) and a rotation cadence (90 days for service accounts; 30 days for short-lived tokens). We use our internal ephemeral vault that enforces TTL on tokens.

If the assessor needs deeper evidence for any single item we can request a limited-time view with an NDA extension.

—Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Core Services
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Reed <amanda.reed@acme-assess.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: code review, CI gating, and secrets ownership

Amanda — uploaded the consolidated bundle to the secure share: https://drive.redwoodinc/internal/playbooks/secure-development-playbook-v3 (folder: /SIG-evidence/Acme-2025-12). Contents: code_review_sample.md, ci_policy_snapshot.pdf, secret-rotation-log.csv (owner hashes and timestamps), change-approval-audit.txt.

Highlights from the rotation CSV (redacted):
- service: acme-ingest-svc, owner: eng-manager:marissa_cole, last_rotation: 2025-10-01T02:14:00Z, method: vault-rotate, entries: 24
- service: acme-analysis-svc, owner: eng-manager:jonas_weber, last_rotation: 2025-11-15T03:05:00Z, method: ephemeral-token

We also exported our CI pipeline policy (policy id JIRA-1234) and added a short change chronology for the hotfix. If assessors want a short live walkthrough (15–20m) of how PR gating + secret rotation appears in the vault UI, we can schedule a session tomorrow.

Let me know if you want any additional redaction or a signed manifest for the artifacts.

Jonas Weber
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
